verdict.rationale: Public status lookup for filings or applications is a fair axis for a national company registry, so it applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt (mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in), and no page content was fetched. Nothing documents a public status-tracking page, so the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the wall blocks the observation itself and does not show the capability is absent for a human founder using a browser.
